signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a raised ranch home frontage with driveway and lawn; utility pole and wires in the foreground partly obstruct the sky but not the house.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Rounded shrubs and a river-rock and mulch bed along the curb look tidy, but there is no crew or equipment, so this is likely homeowner-maintained.

signals.notes: Split-level brick and vinyl-sided home with a two-car garage and a dark SUV parked at the edge of the driveway; the lawn and exterior look well maintained and nothing suggests a sale, move or active work.
